name: autocorrelation_regime_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 5-minute rolling lag-1 autocorrelation of 5-second returns quantifies two competing microstructure forces simultaneously present in the index order book. Positive autocorrelation (> 0.20) signals institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing large directional mandates whose resting orders persist across dozens of 5-second bars, creating momentum that lasts 30-90 seconds; we follow the prevailing 1-minute impulse. Negative autocorrelation (< -0.20) signals short-gamma market makers delta-hedging options books dominating the tape — they reflexively fade each 5-second tick with the opposite side, so every 1-minute move becomes self-correcting; we fade back toward VWAP. The 5-second bar resolution lets us classify and react to regime transitions 12× faster than the original 1-minute formulation, entering at the regime's onset rather than after confirmation.

indicators.name: ret_1
indicators.purpose: 1-bar 5-second return — the raw material for autocorrelation. At 5s bars this is the finest tradeable return series available.

indicators.name: autocorr_60
indicators.purpose: Rolling 5-minute lag-1 autocorrelation. 60 bars chosen because: (1) SE of Pearson r with 60 observations ≈ 0.13, making ±0.20 thresholds statistically meaningful; (2) 5 minutes captures the tenure of a typical institutional TWAP slice or a market-maker hedging cycle — short enough to detect regime transitions intraday. The original used 30 bars of 1-min data (30 minutes of history); at 5s resolution we use 60 bars (5 minutes) because we are predicting the NEXT 30-90 seconds, not the next 10-30 minutes — the relevant regime window compresses proportionally with hold time.

indicators.name: ret_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute directional impulse for entry timing. In momentum regime, confirms an established direction before joining; in reversion regime, measures the size of the move to fade. 12 bars (1 min) is the minimum meaningful impulse at 5s resolution — shorter would pick up noise, longer would miss entry timing.

indicators.name: ema_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute EMA for price-vs-trend confirmation in momentum regime. Aligned with ret_12 so both measure the same 1-minute trend horizon.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at session open
indicators.purpose: Session-cumulative VWAP as mean-reversion anchor. In reversion regime, VWAP distance determines which direction to fade and validates that the move being faded is a genuine excursion. No scaling needed — VWAP is cumulative, not lookback-based.

conditions: MOMENTUM: autocorr_60 > 0.20 AND ret_12 > 0.0012 (12bp 1-min move) AND close > ema_12 (price above 1-min trend)
REVERSION: autocorr_60 < -0.20 AND ret_12 < -0.0015 (15bp down-impulse to fade) AND close < vwap (below VWAP confirms mean-reversion candidate)
buy_ce.confirmation: Signal fires on same bar — no additional confirmation bar (5s bars already slow enough)

conditions: MOMENTUM: autocorr_60 > 0.20 AND ret_12 < -0.0012 AND close < ema_12
REVERSION: autocorr_60 < -0.20 AND ret_12 > 0.0015 AND close > vwap

exit.stop_rationale: Momentum regime: 3 option points. If the institutional TWAP order sustaining momentum has reversed a 6 spot-point retracement (≈3 option pts at delta 0.5) within 30s, the order flow thesis has broken — exit before further damage. NIFTY 30s typical move is 2-5 pts; a 3pt stop is hit only on a genuine reversal.
exit.target_rationale: Reversion regime: 7 option points. A VWAP excursion of 15bp+ reverts at minimum 40-50% in 60-90s (≈7 option pts). Market makers fully cover their delta within 2-3 minutes, so the reversion is fast and typically overshoots slightly — 7pts captures the core reversion without overstaying.
exit.stop_rationale_reversion: Reversion regime: 4 option points. Reversion from VWAP excursion can see a final flush extending another 8 spot pts (≈4 option pts) before snapping back — need wider stop than momentum. If price extends 8+ pts further from VWAP (total move > 23bp on the 1-min), market-maker hedging is overwhelmed by one-sided flow and reversion thesis is wrong.

filters.vix_filter: None — VIX regime does not change autocorrelation signal logic at 5s scale
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST — needs 60-bar (5-min) warmup after 09:20 open for first stable autocorrelation estimate; 15:20 EOD flatten
filters.volume_filter: None — index volume at 5s bars is too noisy for filtering
filters.trend_filter: Regime itself (autocorr threshold) acts as the filter — neutral zone (-0.20 to +0.20) means no trades
filters.spread_filter: Not applicable — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — autocorrelation regimes on NIFTY are driven by structural participants (institutions with TWAP mandates, short-gamma market makers) whose behavior is persistent; however, as HFT proliferates on NSE, the momentum autocorrelation signal may compress over time

adaptation_notes: Key changes from original: (1) Lookback compressed from 30×1min (30 min) to 60×5s (5 min) because hold time is 30-90s vs 10-30min — the regime window must be proportional to the trading horizon; (2) Universe changed from NIFTY50 constituents to NIFTY index itself — index autocorrelation is cleaner and free of bid-ask bounce contamination that the original noted as a weakness for individual stocks; (3) Two separate stop/target levels for momentum vs reversion sub-strategies, calibrated to their different risk profiles; (4) Removed trailing stop (too complex for 30-90s holds); (5) VIX filter removed — VIX doesn't affect the autocorrelation regime classification at 5s scale
weaknesses: At 60 observations, SE of Pearson r ≈ 0.13 — threshold of ±0.20 leaves modest statistical separation; measured autocorr can be in regime but true autocorr neutral, generating spurious signals
NIFTY index at 5s bars still has discretization noise — individual derivative legs crossing prices can create apparent autocorrelation that is not a tradeable institutional signal
Two sub-strategies (momentum + reversion) with different stops mean the realized R:R distribution is bimodal — may require separate Optuna tuning passes
